prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original inline League Reserve cost texticon, consumed at 18x18 pixels.
Primary request: Create a crisp, simple industrial micro-glyph for a pooled civic reserve: a closed upright ledger or register with a broad dark cover and one clear muted-green reserve stripe or seal. Match the compact silhouette, dark outline, and clear value separation of Image 1, while depicting no factory. At 18x18 the book/register silhouette and its single green accent must remain immediately readable.
Input images: Image 1, installed vanilla civ_factory texticon decoded from gfx/texticons/civ_factory.dds, 18x18; transfer only its compact scale, dark outline, and simple painted shading, not the factory shape or orange color.
Style/medium: clean miniature painted glyph with broad forms and very little interior detail, matching vanilla inline texticon readability.
Composition/framing: centered subject filling about 16x16 pixels in an 18x18 transparent canvas, with a clean one-pixel margin; maintain a strong compact outline.
Lighting/mood: restrained highlights on the cover, no glow.
Color palette: charcoal and slate body, a single muted emerald-green accent, neutral grey highlights, near-black 1-pixel outline.
Constraints: request genuine transparency in this initial generation; keep the subject interior opaque and only the unused outer canvas transparent. No readable letters, numerals, currency symbols, flags, extra accent colors, loose pages, tiny writing, background, watermark, coin, or generic currency token.
Avoid: ornate wreaths, detailed book textures, tiny seals, soft blurred edges, gradients outside the silhouette, white matte, checkerboard, coloured spill, halo, or clipped edges.
